placeholderPage.body: This screen arrives with its feature.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: Check the address, or go back to the start page.

validation.failed: Some details are not valid. Check them and try again.

request.invalid: The request could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
request.not-found: This page does not exist. Check the address.
request.method-not-allowed: This action is not available. Reload the page and try again.
request.unsupported-media-type: The request could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
request.forbidden: This page was open too long. Reload it and try again.
request.not-allowed: This is not available for your account.

internal.error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.

account.confirmation-link-invalid: This link no longer works. Request a new one.
account.credentials-invalid: Email or password is wrong. Check both and try again.
account.email-not-confirmed: Confirm your email first, then sign in.
account.sign-in-locked: Too many attempts. Try again later.

invite.account-exists: This email already has an account.
invite.limit-reached: You've sent many invites. Try again later.
invite.not-found: This invite is no longer open.

exercise.name-taken: An exercise with this name is already in the library.
exercise.limit-reached: You've reached the limit of 200 own exercises.

account.passwordRules: 8–128 characters with at least one lower-case letter, one upper-case letter, one digit and one special character.

errors.name: Enter your name.
errors.adult: Confirm that you are 18 or older.

signInPage.title: Sign in
signInPage.description: Trainers and clients sign in here.
signInPage.unconfirmedBody: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it, then sign in.
signInPage.newTrainer: New trainer? <signUp>Create an account</signUp>. Clients join from their trainer's invite.

signUp.title: Create your trainer account
signUp.description: Your clients join later, from your invite.
signUp.name: Name

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.description: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to confirm your account.
checkEmail.hint: No email? Check your spam folder first.
checkEmail.resent: Sent again. You can send another link in a minute.

confirmed.title: Email confirmed
confirmed.description: Your trainer account is ready. Sign in to start.

expired.title: This link no longer works
expired.description: Confirmation links work once and expire after 24 hours. Enter your email to get a new one.

quiz.answersStay: Your answers stay if you go back.

goal.title: What do you train for?
goal.hint: Pick one. Your trainer can change it later.

experience.title: How long have you trained regularly?
experience.hint: Count the time you trained at least twice a week.

level.title: Which fits you best?
level.hint: Your trainer uses this to set your first weights.

ATHLETE.title: Athlete
ATHLETE.description: You compete or train like it

about.title: About you
about.hint: Your trainer uses these to set starting weights.

height.label: Height
height.error: Enter a height between 120 and 230 cm.

weight.label: Body weight
weight.error: Enter a weight between 30 and 250 kg.
weight.note: Switch to lb later in settings.

likes.title: What do you like to train?

days.title: How many days a week can you train?
days.hint: Count the days you can really keep.

notes.title: Anything your trainer should know?
notes.hint: Injuries, limits, equipment you don't have. Optional.
notes.label: Notes for your trainer
notes.placeholder: e.g. Left knee gets stiff on deep squats

review.label: Review
review.title: Check your answers
review.hint: Your first plan is built from these 7 answers. Your trainer checks it before you see it.
review.about_one: {{count, number}} year · {{height, number}} cm · {{weight, number}} kg
review.about_other: {{count, number}} years · {{height, number}} cm · {{weight, number}} kg
review.later: You can change them later with your trainer.

invites.title: Open invites
invites.description: A client who joins moves to All clients. Links stop working when they expire or you revoke them.
invites.empty: No open invites. Invites you send show up here until the client joins.
invites.copyNewLinkHint: The link you copied before stops working.
invites.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it.

dialog.title: Invite a client
dialog.description: We email them a link to join you. You can copy the link too.
dialog.sentDescription: The link works for 7 days. Copy it to send it another way.
dialog.linkWarning: Anyone with the link can join as this client. Send it only to them.

newLinkDialog.title: New link for {{email}}
newLinkDialog.description: The link you copied before no longer works. Copy this one to send it.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke the invite for {{email}}?
revokeDialog.description: The link stops working. You can send a new invite later.
